events.title: 리버풀's hopes of retaining their league title are hit by a 1–0 defeat away to 셰필드 유나이티드 .
리버풀 draw 0–0 at home to 에버턴, allowing 리즈 유나이티드 to move to the verge of the title with a 3–2 win over 입스위치 타운. 노리치 시티 are relegated to the Second Division.
리버풀's 1–0 home defeat by 아스널 ends their double hopes and hands the league title to 리즈 유나이티드.

맨체스터 유나이티드 go into the Manchester derby at Old Trafford needing to beat neighbours City to stand any chance of avoiding relegation, six years after winning the European Cup . They lose 1–0 with former club hero Denis Law scoring City's only goal, but would have been relegated even if they had won due to 버밍엄 시티 winning. Birmingham's win also relegates 사우샘프턴, despite the Saints' 3–0 win away to 에버턴. 리즈 유나이티드 end the season with a 1–0 away win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스 .
